VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Descripti: System configuration overlay for the user login gate. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by the ConfigLoader, so read every value through StateManager.VghLantern__StateManager__GetAppConfig() rather than fetching this file directly. The login is a prototype gate over the landing screen backed by test accounts in Na__UserLogin__UserAccounts__.json; a successful sign in is remembered in a cookie so the gate is skipped on the next visit.

VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Session.CookieLifetimeNote: One month, per the product decision that a signed in user should not be asked again on this device. Clearing the cookie (or the Sign out link on the landing screen) re-arms the gate.

VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.AvatarMaxInitialsNote: How many letters the header avatar carries. Two reads as a monogram (Adam Noble becomes AN); a longer name spends its last slot on the final word, so the surname is never the letter that gets dropped.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.RoleFallbackNote: Second line of the menu identity block for an account whose record carries no Role.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.HomeScreenNote: Returns to the landing card from any mode. The loaded project is left untouched, so leaving the landing screen again lands back on the same drawing.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.SignOutNote: Switch User and Sign Out run the same routine: clear the session cookie and re-open the login gate over the landing screen. Two labels, because the two mental models arrive at the same place.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperMenuRolesNote: Account roles the Developer Tools section is rendered for, matched against the Role on the signed in account record. An account outside this list never sees the section and never has its actions wired up, so a sales user cannot reach an export by guessing at an action key.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperSketchUpNote: Writes the current lantern as a millimetre build payload for the Vale Lantern Importer in SketchUp. The lantern exported is always the one on screen.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperCadNote: Writes the current lantern's plan and elevations as one layered DXF. Not yet built - the menu item reports that rather than failing silently.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__AccountMe.DeveloperSectionNote: A nested section rather than two more top level items: the account menu is a place a signed in user looks for their own identity and session, and two developer exports sitting between Home Screen and Sign Out would read as ordinary features of the application to everybody who is not a developer.

VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Copy.ModalSubtitle: Enter your Vale Design Suite credentials. Your session is remembered on this device for one month.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Copy.ErrorMissingFields: Enter your user name and password.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Copy.ErrorUnknownUser: User name or password not recognised.
VghLantern__UserLogin__Config__Copy.ErrorAccountsUnavailable: The user account list could not be loaded. See the console for detail.
